title: Surreal Cereal Vortex
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a pink bowl of cereal at the center of swirling concentric circles that form a vortex. Two translucent figures wearing hats stand in a green field under a purple sky, surrounded by exploding starbursts, floating concentric circles, and colorful splashes of paint.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting with a pink bowl of cereal exploding at the center of a swirling colorful vortex made of concentric circles in orange, teal, and purple. Two ghostly figures wearing wide-brimmed hats stand in a wavy green field in the background. Bright blue starburst splashes, floating concentric target circles, and dynamic paint splatters across a lavender sky. Vibrant, playful, and highly detailed acrylic style.
